caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate chair placed against a plain, beige background. The chair features a richly detailed wooden frame with intricate, carved designs along the top of the chair back and under the seat. The legs of the chair are curved and decorative. Both the seat and the backrest are upholstered with reddish-pink fabric that has a button-tufted texture on the backrest and a subtle floral or patterned design on the seat cushion. There are no additional objects or decorations in the image, and the light appears evenly distributed across the scene. The artist's signature is present in the lower right-hand corner of the drawing.
title: Side Chair
